description: This file defines the onboarding user interface and controller logic for a macOS application called OpenClaw. It includes classes and structures for managing onboarding flow, displaying onboarding views, handling remote onboarding states, and coordinating UI elements like windows and pages.

classes.name: OnboardingController
classes.description: A singleton controller managing the presentation and dismissal of the onboarding window in a SwiftUI macOS app.

classes.name: OnboardingView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view struct that manages the onboarding UI flow, including pages, permissions, workspace setup, CLI installation, and remote gateway configuration.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the onboarding window or activates the existing one, respecting the Nix mode setting.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the onboarding window if it is open.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Closes and then re-displays the onboarding window.
